findings.finding: Trajectory feedforward and bounded tracking feedback can be combined with the existing rotor controller. Under wind, ground normal force is only one term in vertical force balance; drag and rotor thrust must be aligned to the interval that produced the measured contact force.
findings.relevance: Combining the measured calm contact route and airborne wind model in one physics experiment
findings.direction_alignment: Implements the next slice named in the prior delivery and the maintainer's explicit continuation after merging it.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Wind during descent exposes tracking and touchdown behavior absent from either earlier experiment; five seeds cannot establish general wind robustness.
findings.engineering_cost: One trajectory-control and turbulence mission slice using existing physics and replay infrastructure
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-009 turbulent takeoff, waypoint route and contact landing with independent acceptance gates
findings.verification_needed: Controller/force-timing tests, clean-source seeded GPU missions, strict evidence validation and measured 3D inspection

overall_recommendation: Continue with a bounded turbulent contact mission while preserving established contracts and distinguishing engineering acceptance from atmospheric or hardware validation.
evidence_gaps: No calibrated wind or propeller/ground-effect model
Final turbulent contact trials have not yet run
